severity_rule.Blocker: any normalized-raw or timestamped-session key connects test with train or validation
severity_rule.Risk: no test overlap, but a normalized-raw or timestamped-session key connects train with validation
severity_rule.Pass: all mechanical gates pass and neither key type crosses any partition
severity_rule.Unknown: required raw data, split maps, metadata, or reliable grouping fields cannot be verified

allowed_inference: Determine whether the historical target-only oracle split is row-disjoint, normalized-raw-disjoint, and timestamped-session-disjoint.
Quantify test rows whose raw or session key also occurs in training or validation.
Classify the historical oracle ceiling as clean, at risk, or blocked under the frozen criteria.
forbidden_inference: Correct historical oracle metrics without retraining.
Claim that overlap proves the numerical amount of metric inflation.
Treat row-id disjointness as raw-record or session independence.
Use approximate indices or substitute grouping columns when exact archived inputs are unavailable.
